finding: The S=32 correctness prefill and batch-32 decode both have 32 matrix rows. The old <= TILE_SIZE heuristic therefore selected the decode-only packed BFP4 tensor during prefill.

fix.branch_control: MultichipDecoder now records the explicit public forward phase and excludes decode DRAM weights during prefill.
fix.construction_control: A decode-only packed precision copy is independently uploaded from per-rank host gate/up slices instead of being typecast from the prefill device tensor.
fix.lifetime_control: Non-packed device typecast intermediates remain retained on the decoder.
fix.mapping_control: A CPU unit test proves each TP rank receives [gate_i, up_i], not gate-only/up-only global chunks.
